defs.d: Son of the same parents as another person.
A male having at least one parent in common with another (see half-brother, stepbrother).
To treat as a brother.
Expressing exasperation.
defs.ex: We're being forced to work overtime? Oh, brother!

defs.d: A soft, fatty foodstuff made by churning the cream of milk (generally cow's milk).
Any of various foodstuffs made from other foods or oils, similar in consistency to, eaten like or intended as a substitute for butter (preceded by the name of the food used to make it).
defs.ex: peanut butter

defs.d: To spread butter on.
defs.ex: Butter the toast.

defs.d: To move one's weight backwards or forwards onto the tips or tails of one's skis or snowboard so only the tip or tail is in contact with the snow.

One whose activities make use of the scientific method to answer questions regarding the measurable universe. A scientist may be involved in original research, or make use of the results of the research of others.
A star, especially when seen as the centre of any single solar system.
The light and warmth which is received from the sun.
To expose to the warmth and radiation of the sun.
defs.ex: Beautiful bodies lying on the beach, sunning their bronzed limbs.

defs.d: To warm or dry in the sunshine.
The star that the Earth revolves around and from which it receives light and warmth.
A vehicle that may be hired for single journeys by members of the public, driven by a taxi driver.
A share taxi.
To move an aircraft on the ground under its own power.
defs.ex: taxi down the runway

defs.d: To travel by taxicab.
A partially specified but unnamed person.
defs.ex: Do you need a gift for that special someone?

defs.d: An important person
defs.ex: He thinks he has become someone.

defs.d: Some person.
defs.ex: Can someone help me, please?

defs.d: The presiding cook in the kitchen of a large household.
The head cook of a restaurant or other establishment.
To work as a chef; to prepare and cook food professionally.
To stab with a knife, to shank, to lacerate with a rambo.

A sport common in North America, the Caribbean, and Japan, in which the object is to strike a ball so that one of a nine-person team can run counter-clockwise among four bases, resulting in the scoring of a run. The team with the most runs after termination of play, usually nine innings, wins.
The ball used to play the sport of baseball.
A division, a portion, a share.
defs.ex: We gave three deals of grain in tribute to the king.

defs.d: (often followed by of) An indefinite quantity or amount; a lot (now usually qualified by great or good).
Control or occupancy of something for which one does not necessarily have private property rights.
Something that is owned.
defs.ex: I would gladly give all of my worldly possessions just to be able to do that.

defs.d: To invest with property.
The external covering at the top of a building.
defs.ex: The roof was blown off by the tornado.

defs.d: The top external level of a building.
defs.ex: Let's go up to the roof.

defs.d: Anything that is typical, normal, or standard.
defs.ex: Among the moths, typicals were more common than melanics.

defs.d: Capturing the overall sense of a thing.
Characteristically representing something by form, group, idea or type.
To grasp a concept fully and thoroughly, especially (of words, statements, art, etc.) to be aware of the meaning of and (of people) to be aware of the intent of.
defs.ex: I'm sorry. I don't understand.

defs.d: To believe, to think one grasps sufficiently despite potentially incomplete knowledge.
defs.ex: I understand that you have a package for me?

defs.d: (gerund) The act of one that understands or comprehends; comprehension; knowledge; discernment.
Reason or intelligence, ability to grasp the full meaning of knowledge, ability to infer.
Showing compassion.
Knowing; skilful.
Any specific chemical element or chemical compound or alloy.
An artificial chemical compound.
Of or relating to chemistry.
Of or relating to a material or processes not commonly found in nature or in a particular product.
The act or fact of communicating anything; transmission.
defs.ex: communication of a secret

defs.d: The concept or state of exchanging data or information between entities.
defs.ex: Some say that communication is a necessary prerequisite for sentience; others say that it is a result thereof.

defs.d: An attitude of consideration or high regard
defs.ex: He is an intellectual giant, and I have great respect for him.

defs.d: Good opinion, honor, or admiration
To have respect for.
defs.ex: She is an intellectual giant, and I respect her greatly.

defs.d: To have regard for something, to observe a custom, practice, rule or right.
defs.ex: I respect your right to hold that belief, although I think it is nonsense.

defs.d: Hello, hi
To join in, to take part, to involve oneself (in something).
To share, share in (something).
Acting in common; participating.
The part of the mind that is aware of itself; the consciousness.
Alert, awake; with one's mental faculties active.
defs.ex: The noise woke me, but it was another few minutes before I was fully conscious.

defs.d: Aware of one's own existence; aware of one's own awareness.
defs.ex: Only highly intelligent beings can be fully conscious.

defs.d: Intentionally, or after deliberation; not accidentally.
defs.ex: He deliberately broke that, didn't he?

defs.d: Taking one's time, slowly and carefully.
defs.ex: After being called upon, he strode deliberately up to the blackboard.

defs.d: A show or spectacle.
defs.ex: The trapeze artist put on an amazing acrobatic display.

defs.d: A piece of work to be presented visually.
defs.ex: Pupils are expected to produce a wall display about a country of their choice.

defs.d: To show conspicuously; to exhibit; to demonstrate; to manifest.
To make a display; to act as one making a show or demonstration.
A sight or view of the interior of anything; a deep inspection or view; introspection; frequently used with into.
Power of acute observation and deduction
Strained; tightly drawn.
Strict, very close or earnest.
defs.ex: intense study;  intense thought
